source_title: 'Titans' BO day 8: Jayasurya's film trails 'Aadu 3' by Rs 34.08 cr
source_excerpt: Jayasurya and Vinayakan's Malayalam movie 'Titans' is yet to make a significant impact at the box office. The film, starring the duo, arrived following the success of 'Aadu 3', but its collections have remained modest during the opening week. According to Sacnilk, 'Titans' earned Rs 11 lakh net in India on Thursday, October 29. The amount was collected through 480 shows across the country.With the latest earnings, the movie's domestic net collection has reached Rs 2.55 cr. Its India gross stands at Rs 2.95 cr. Thursday's contribution accounted for 4.3% of its total domestic net earnings. The film has now entered its second week in theaters, although its daily collections have continued to decline.'Titans' box office collection: Day 8 comparison with 'Aadu 3'The difference in the box office performance of 'Titans' and 'Aadu 3' is evident from their respective collections on the eighth day. At the same stage, 'Aadu 3' had earned Rs 1.60 cr net in India from 1,292 shows. Its domestic net collection had reached Rs 36.63 cr, while the India gross stood at Rs 42.35 cr.'Aadu 3' also collected Rs 65 lakh from overseas markets on Day 8. Its cumulative overseas gross reached Rs 57.65 cr, taking the worldwide collection to Rs 100 cr. By comparison, 'Titans' has earned Rs 2.55 cr in domestic net collections. The difference between their India net collections stands at Rs 34.08 cr.'Titans' daily box office collection'Titans' began its theatrical run with Rs 65 lakh on October 22. The film collected Rs 35 lakh the following day before registering an improvement over the weekend. Saturday brought in Rs 43 lakh, while Sunday's earnings reached Rs 52 lakh, its highest single-day collection so far.The movie's earnings subsequently declined during the weekdays. Monday contributed Rs 21 lakh, followed by Rs 15 lakh on Tuesday.
